arrival.text: THE ELDERWork's on the board, mijo. Men for hire wait at the posts, and the bar has drink.

ask.name: MARI LUZ, THE SIGN PAINTER
ask.said: A place without a name is a place you leave, and my eleven tins of paint sit past the hyenas. Bring them and I name it after whoever you want, plus 45 batteries.

client.name: MARI LUZ, THE SIGN PAINTER
client.text: Fetch the paint for the hall signMARI LUZ, THE SIGN PAINTER 45 batteries · 2 H
